draft.summary: NFL.com graded him 5.82, the 211th-best grade among 259 2023 draftees and 20th of 23 at DT. He went 200th overall, close to where his grade ranked. Testing was middle of the pack for his position, with no result in the top or bottom 20%. College production: 2 sacks in 2022, 13th of 23 DTs in his class with stats.

current.summary: Year 4 pro, currently with the Los Angeles Chargers (reserve / out). 45 career games and 19 starts over 3 completed seasons. Producing near his peak: 5 AV in 2025 against a career-best 6 in 2024. Weak spots: season snap share 1.8% (0th percentile), pressures 0 (4th percentile). Versus the typical Year-3 interior lineman who played: 0 pressures against a median of 4, below the norm.
